_comment: A VIDEO GAME, set up as a MOVIE ("type": "movie"): one 'episode', the release, marked as an event, so the popup offers 'Hide content' / 'Show content' and everything about it is covered (story, ending, missions, cutscenes, leaks, trailers) until the user chooses Show content. Added 2026-11-19 at Selly's request ('Add it, rename later'; the product name stays '...for Movies & TV' for now). Release: Thu Nov 19 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, unlocking at midnight local time in each store region (Rockstar/Take-Two; no PC version announced). Characters from Rockstar's character pages and trailers: Jason Duval, Lucia Caminos, Cal Hampton, Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest, Real Dimez, Raul Bautista, Brian Heder. Voice cast as reported (Nov 2026; Jason's actor not confirmed by Rockstar): Dylan Rourke (Jason), Manni L. Perez (Lucia), Bobby Moynihan (Cal), Stephen Root. Actors are weak and everyday (they appear in posts about their other work). Places: the state of Leonida with Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga. 'GTA' alone is weak and everyday: it also means the Greater Toronto Area. 'Vice City' is weak (also a nickname for Miami and the 2002 game). Jason, Lucia, Cal, Boobie and Ambrosia are everyday words. @RockstarGames is listed as an account: it mostly posts about GTA VI now (also Red Dead and GTA Online).
